A rating's uncertainty, source by source (S7)

Source: R/rating_uncertainty.R
FlodeUncertainty.Rd

What rating_uncertainty() returns.

  • bands: one row per stage and source, with stage_m, source ("sampling", "gauging", "combined" or "structure"), lower, median and upper for the intervals, min and max with variant_min and variant_max for structure (a range, never an interval), rating_cms (the rating itself) and support ("observed" or "extrapolation", beyond the gauged range, not to be read as reliable).

  • assessed: one row per source, whether it was assessed and, if not, why.

  • settings: the draws, the level, the seed, the group column, the u used for each group and where it came from.

  • draws_failed: per source, the draws that could not be refitted.

  • variants: the structural variants tried, and whether each fitted.

None of it is a complete uncertainty budget: stage error is not modelled.

Usage

FlodeUncertainty(
  bands = data.table(),
  assessed = data.table(),
  settings = list(),
  draws_failed = data.table(),
  variants = data.table()
)

Arguments

bands, assessed, draws_failed, variants

Tables, as above.

settings

A list, as above.

Value

A FlodeUncertainty.

See also

rating_uncertainty(), uncertainty_bands()

Examples

set.seed(1)
stage_m <- sort(runif(25, 0.3, 3))
fit <- fit_rating(data.frame(stage_m = stage_m,
                             discharge_cms = 3 * stage_m^1.6 * exp(rnorm(25, sd = 0.05))), quiet = TRUE)
u <- rating_uncertainty(fit, n_draws = 100, sources = "sampling", seed = 1)
u@assessed
#>      source assessed reason
#>      <char>   <lgcl> <char>
#> 1: sampling     TRUE   <NA>
